title: Generate one-bedroom apartment flythrough video
objective: Use the documented SPEAR flythrough pipeline to generate a good-looking flythrough MP4 for the imported Infinigen one_bed_apartment scene.
instructions: Follow docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md 'Generating flythrough videos', adapting paths for one_bed_apartment.
Use a pipeline output directory that is easy to find and disposable, e.g. /home/yashturkar/Workspace/spear-pipeline/scenes/one_bed_apartment_flythrough or a clearly named equivalent.
Run long editor/render commands inside tmux so the user can attach and monitor; report the tmux session/window name.
If the standard pipeline generates multiple videos, identify the best/most complete one and provide its path; preserve all generated outputs.
If a user_config.yaml is needed for map, camera, or render settings, create it only as a generated artifact in the pipeline output directory, not as product code.
Do not commit. Do not push. Avoid changing tracked product code unless absolutely necessary to make the documented workflow run, and report any such changes before making them if feasible.
constraints: Keep runtime artifacts out of Git; do not stage anything.
Prefer a lean first pass over over-tuning: a usable MP4 is the target.
expected_outputs: Path(s) to generated MP4 flythrough video(s).
Exact command sequence or tmux session used.
Any blockers/failures with the first failing command and relevant log path.
definition_of_done: At least one MP4 flythrough video exists and can be played/inspected, or a precise blocker is reported with logs.
ResultPacket includes output directory, best video path, and remaining cleanup/status notes.
